title: The built-in reward
summary: Rebuild the rules a run without a script trains on, one line at a time, until your script matches the Intermediate preset.

steps.title: More for a quick finish
steps.body:
A run without a script still trains on rules, written in the app. This lesson rebuilds them in your script.

The finish bonus first. It pays 10, plus up to 10 more for time to spare. `agent.time / agent.timeLimit` is the share of the clock used, so one minus it is the share left. `max(0, ...)` keeps it from going below zero.

Replace the finish line with the bigger bonus.

check.message: The test run should score more than 22 points.

hints: Keep reward +10 and add the time bonus to it, before the word when.
Inside max, put 1 minus agent.time divided by agent.timeLimit. Multiply max by 10 and add it to the 10 already there.

steps.title: The cost of dying
steps.body: Dying takes 3 points away. That undoes about a third of a whole run, enough to make a detour round the spikes worth it, but not so much that runners fear every step.
hints: A penalty is a reward with a minus sign.

steps.title: The small costs
steps.body:
Two tiny costs finish the job. Standing still (under 0.3 m/s either way) costs 0.005 a tick, so waiting for a mover is fine but dawdling is not. Backing up (0.3 m/s or more) costs 0.03 a tick. Runners turn tighter in reverse, and without it a population soon backs all the way to the line.

Add both. Then your script trains exactly like a run without one, and the check confirms it matches the Intermediate preset.

check.message: Your script should do exactly what the Intermediate preset does.

hints: abs(agent.speed) is the speed either way, forward or back.
Write reward -0.005 when abs(agent.speed) < 0.3 m/s, then reward -0.03 when agent.speed <= -0.3 m/s.
